gap: Can first-order current/history motion sensitivity regularization remove the fast readout's angular recurrence loss while preserving its local accuracy and update speed?
initialization: Three fresh prefix-only OnlineFit constructions per case; require identical parameters and normalizers. No saved fits initialize any arm. Count prefix acquisition, initialization, compilation and first prediction/update separately. Source begin:first inclusive states and begin:first commands only. Scoring begins1.25s quad /0.75s fixedwing, not immediate throw identification. Reset every case. Learned feature, filter, memory and normalization values in both readouts remain frozen after this fresh prefix.

arms.baseline: Unchanged public OnlineFit with16-PCG full-model update.
arms.curvature: Unchanged CurvedReadout from6d2b9c4; exact numerical replay required against saved full-stream control, including phi,target,penalty,mean and conditional predictions.
arms.candidate: Same curvature readout plus the single sensitivity penalty below. No forgetting, extra gradient fit, response clamps, acceptance guard, altered integrator, or tuned strengths.

penalty.coordinates: xi contains the six supported normalized body-motion coordinates (body velocity and body rate) at the measured midpoint and each of D lag rows, independently:6*(D+1) coordinates. Unit size equals the prefix body normalization before the existing saturation. Derivatives are with respect to supported coordinates themselves, after saturation, avoiding a vanishing derivative solely from an extreme recorded state. Hold gravity direction, issued/filtered commands and accumulator state fixed. This is readout-coordinate sensitivity, not the full physical recurrence Jacobian or a sensor-noise likelihood.
penalty.domain: One probe per causally revealed post-prefix transition: the exact existing measured-midpoint phi with its incoming lag/memory. Retain the sum over all assimilated probes. No future samples or sampled off-trajectory data. No prefix rows re-assimilated and no candidate change before the first prediction.
penalty.derivative: D_i=d(phi_i)/d(xi_i), shape P by6*(D+1). Full linear block has current+lag-difference derivatives, including minus-current in every lag; quadratic derivative is exact in current supported coordinates; bias zero; frozen tanh derivative exact, including temporal projection. Every readout path participates. Feature derivatives do not depend on fitted readout coefficients. Compute analytically, test against JAX autodiff and finite differences. Reconstruct independently from saved phi and fresh initial arrays for verification.
penalty.objective: Retain existing data/prefix ridge and curvature terms exactly. Add eta/(6*n)*sum_l beta_l^2*sum_i ||D_i.T@M_l||^2, eta=.01, beta_l=dt*output_scale_l/first-step loss_scale_l. This is first-order perturbation regularization at perturbation scale0.1 in normalized supported coordinates, not a claim that actual sensor noise is10% of prefix spread. It shrinks positive and negative feedback and can bias real dynamics. Constant strength relative to mean data error; not a decaying Bayesian prior or stability certificate.
penalty.solve: S_n=S_(n-1)+D_i@D_i.T; G=lambda*I+sum phi*phi.T; Q=lambda*M0+sum phi*y.T. Solve (G+diag(existing_curvature_penalty_n)+eta*S_n)M=Q with the same diagonal-equilibrated Cholesky shared across six outputs. Preserve data sufficient statistics separately. Initialize S=0; lambda=.01*prefix initialized_transition_count. No matrix inverse, numerical jitter or coefficient clipping.

evaluation.measurement: Unchanged measured midpoint features and increment targets from6d2b9c4. Only states, issued commands and timing; no simulator acceleration or vehicle metadata. Each one-step forecast is scored before revealing the next state. Future commands appear only in retrospective conditional forecast scoring, never model updates.
evaluation.conditional: At every16th update offset including0, record complete250ms forecasts when truth exists. Score50,100,150,200,250ms separately for physical velocity-vector, body-rate-vector and orientation RMSE. Every origin, including initial and extreme cases, contributes.
evaluation.aggregation: Candidate/full and candidate/curvature ratios: geometric mean of case ratios within family, then equal families; denominator floor1e-9. Velocity/rate primary is their geometric mean. Save first16/after16,first100/after100,and pre/post4s when available. Record truncated quad135 and duplicated early quad-change honestly.
evaluation.timing: Single exclusive CPU process; rotate baseline,curvature,candidate update order. Synchronize complete observe plus model snapshot, including derivative construction, Gram accumulation, Cholesky, host conversion and cache management. Save every latency, construction and first-use cost; warm median/p95 exclude only first update. No controller, scheduler or new hardware claims.
evaluation.stopping: Finish full bounded roster unless nonfinite forecast/model, exception, or600s budget. Preserve partial evidence on failure. No outcome-driven strength retuning. Report all results regardless of flags; flag failures inform an overall engineering decision.
evaluation.mechanism_target: Reduce each fixedwing recording's250ms rate error relative to unchanged curvature readout. Report regressions and absolute error alongside this targeted comparison; no automatic adoption.

verification: Commit protocol before implementation and source before experiment. Tests: analytic derivative versus independent JAX and finite differences for3/4 inputs and2/10 lags; current-history sign coupling; penalized solve versus augmented least squares; frozen arrays/causal duplicate rejection. Authenticate source tapes and saved control. Replay baseline and curvature predictions/finals exactly; candidate phi,target,curvature penalty must match curvature control exactly. Save all candidate means,phi,target,penalties, final G/Q/S, initial/final models, predictions and times. Rebuild sensitivity using independent NumPy calculus; componentwise stationarity backward error<=1e-10 at every solve. Recompute all metrics and flags without fitting, reject altered artifacts. No full production suite required because production unchanged.
scope: One architectural penalty experiment; no live Throw/Dart recovery, noise calibration, or matched50ms quad collection. Family and sample interval remain confounded until that separate fixture exists. Cold start still prohibits fleet-trained features/priors.
